_comment: reg_init value-injection demo (#108). Same design/ports as sim_config.json, plus a reg_init that deposits a definite value into the otherwise-unreset `unreset_count` counter at tick 0 ($deposit semantics). Under --xprop this clears the power-up X, so q_unreset (= unreset_count[0]) now reads KNOWN 0/1 for the whole run instead of X. See tests/xprop_cosim/check.py mode reg-init.
